system.description:
Your body has been compromised by the Hebi’s Viper Blood. Good Luck.

A Virulent creature cannot regain hit or chakra points.

A Virulent creature cannot gain temporary hit points or chakra points.

A Virulent creature reduces its damage die size by 1 step. If they use a d4, it instead becomes 1 damage, per dice that would be rolled.

Creatures that are resistant or immune to poison damage or the Envenomed condition are resistant or immune to the Virulent condition.

A creature can spend its action to make a DC 15 Constitution check to remove this condition.
system.summary: Can't regain or gain temporary HP or CP; damage dice one step smaller (d4 becomes 1); DC 15 Constitution check to end.

rules.text: Can't regain hit or chakra points and can't gain temporary hit or chakra points. Its damage dice are one step smaller (a d4 becomes 1 per die). Resistance or immunity to poison damage or Envenomed gives the same against Virulent.
